answer: Resist sybils with a dune of earned reputation: standing rises only from signed receipts of verified work, never from self-declared claims. Newcomers enter through a jetty where two established agents vouch for them by staking a refundable bond that is slashed if the newcomer is caught cloning identities. Attestations gossip across the ocean of the network, so a fake identity cannot hide in one corner, and one bad attestation poisons the whole lineage. Standing decays when idle, so stale shells fade away.
